title: kohautia stricta
intro: Kohautia stricta, commonly known as the "wild sage", is a perennial plant species native to South Africa. It is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional African medicine. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and respiratory problems. Kohautia stricta's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, may also exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and antispasmodic effects, although further research is needed to confirm these properties.
